tool_spec.name: create_drive_folder
tool_spec.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive. Optionally specify a parent folder. Returns folder ID and web link. Use this to organize files.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID (optional, creates in root if not specified)

tool_spec.name: list_folder_contents
tool_spec.description: List all files and folders within a specific Google Drive folder. Returns metadata for each item including name, type, ID, and web link. Use this to browse folder contents.

folder_id.description: The Google Drive folder ID to list contents from

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000). Default: 100

tool_spec.name: get_folder_metadata
tool_spec.description: Get comprehensive metadata for a Google Drive folder including permissions and sharing settings. Use this to inspect folder details.

tool_spec.name: update_drive_folder
tool_spec.description: Update Google Drive folder properties including name, description, and color. Use this to rename or organize folders.

folder_color_rgb.description: Folder color in RGB hex format like '#ff0000' for red (optional)

tool_spec.name: delete_drive_file
tool_spec.description: Delete a file or folder from Google Drive (moves to trash). Use this to remove unwanted files or folders.

file_id.description: The file or folder ID to delete

tool_spec.name: share_drive_folder
tool_spec.description: Share a Google Drive folder with a user or group by email. Specify permission level (reader, writer, commenter). Use this to grant folder access.

email.description: Email address of the user or group to share with

role.description: Permission role: 'reader' (view only), 'writer' (can edit), 'commenter' (can comment). Default: 'reader'

send_notification.description: Whether to send email notification to the user. Default: false

tool_spec.name: share_drive_file
tool_spec.description: Share a Google Drive file with a user or group by email. Specify permission level (reader, writer, commenter). Use this to grant file access.

email.description: Email address of the user or group to share with

role.description: Permission role: 'reader' (view only), 'writer' (can edit), 'commenter' (can comment). Default: 'reader'

send_notification.description: Whether to send email notification to the user. Default: false

tool_spec.name: get_file_metadata
tool_spec.description: Get comprehensive metadata for a Google Drive file including permissions, MIME type, size, and sharing settings. Use this to inspect file details.

tool_spec.name: rename_drive_file
tool_spec.description: Rename a file or folder in Google Drive. Use this to change file or folder names.

file_id.description: The file or folder ID to rename

new_name.description: New name for the file or folder

tool_spec.name: create_drive_file
tool_spec.description: Create a new file in Google Drive with specified name and MIME type. Optionally place it in a specific folder. Use this to create empty files.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., 'text/plain', 'application/pdf'). Default: 'text/plain'

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID to create the file in (optional)

tool_spec.name: update_file_content
tool_spec.description: Update the content of an existing file in Google Drive. Use this to modify text file contents.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the content. Default: 'text/plain'
